Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL1614038. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, and join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to enforce structure presence. Filter where assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614038', activities.standard_value is not null, and activities.standard_relation = '='. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
